newsitem.title: FRANCE: Poll finds French favour private pension funds.
newsitem.headline: Poll finds French favour private pension funds.

text.p: Sixty-four percent of French people polled were in favour of establishing private pension funds to augment their retirement income, according to a BVA survey released on Tuesday.

The survey of 913 people, carried out on November 21-23 for BFM radio, found that the approval rating rose in line with income levels. Seventy-two percent of people in higher income brackets favoured the creation of private pension funds, compared with 61 percent of people with modest incomes.
The French parliament last week approved a bill to establish private pension funds in France.
